enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Path of the Guarding Stone: While wearing this item and in mountain stance, there is a chance you will be protected by a Stoneskin spell when enemies strike you.
Stunning +7: +7 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.

Stone Prison: This weapon is invested with the power of the earth. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will attempt to turn the target to stone, as the Flesh to Stone spell. A successful Fortitude save (DC 27) negates this effect.
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +3d8 damage.
